comment: Base bundles for USB flashing - see FLASH_PLAN.md. Bootloaders MUST come from the same framework the firmware is built against: generated from pioarduino framework-arduinoespressif32-libs/<chip>/bin/bootloader_qio_80m.elf via 'esptool elf2image --flash-mode dio --flash-freq 80m --flash-size 4MB'. The C3 one is byte-identical to a real pioarduino build; S2/S3 use the same recipe but are unverified against a reference build. The Arduino IDE core's dio_80m ELF produces a DIFFERENT bootloader that did not work. Flash-size independent (esptool patches the header at write time). Partition tables are chip-independent, and are the core's stock CSVs, so they match what a PlatformIO env using the same scheme writes. boot_app0.bin is universal.
